description: The surface stability contract (govstruct PRD section 5.1). It says which fields of each emitted surface a consumer may rely on, so an integrator pins a schemaVersion and upgrades consciously, and refuses nameably rather than generically. A field marked contract:true is promised: its type is fixed, and removing or retyping it is a breaking change that needs a schemaVersion bump. optional:true means the field may be absent (a conditional spread), but when present it carries the stated type. contract:false means free-form: it may change without notice and a consumer must not depend on it.

registry.description: The suite roll-up a consumer reads (creadev.org, vant's connector, railyard). A projection of apps.json.

schemaVersion.note: the payload shape; a consumer pins it

generated.note: { by, surface, manifest } - the producer and the manifest checksum the copy proves

address.note: the address and cache contract (path, url, etag, maxAge, cacheControl, checksum)

graph.note: one row per member: { id, needs[], neededBy[] }

members.note: the rendered member summary rows (see registry-member)

registry-member.description: One row of registry.members[]: the summary projection a consumer renders. Narrower than the full member record.

role.note: arm | forge | factory | composer | product | component

status.note: Live | Beta | In Development | Backburner | Archived | Tombstoned

repo.note: owner/name, or null; absent when unset

npm.note: the published name, or null; absent when unset

pending.note: declared-but-not-live resources: { resources: [repo|npm|url], interim?, note? }; absent when every declared resource is live

member.description: One row of apps.members[]: the full member record an integrator binds to.

role.note: arm | forge | factory | composer | product | component

status.note: Live | Beta | In Development | Backburner | Archived | Tombstoned

clause.note: ISO clause annotations; absent when a member declares none

pending.note: declared-but-not-live resources: { resources: [repo|npm|url], interim?, note? }; absent when every declared resource is live

apps.description: The canonical composed source (members + compliance + meta). registry.json is one rendering of it.

compliance.note: the per-member compliance blocks; the shape is owned by the compliance contract, not this surface
